description: Erneuerbare Energien Vogtlandkreis is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. Overview of existing plants on the topic of "renewable energies" in the Vogtlandkreis. Renewable energy plays an increasingly important role in public life, especially in climate protection and energy efficiency issues. The Vogtlandkreis has taken up this topic and wants to use more and more regionally available energy sources for supply in the future. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Renewable energies Vogtlandkreis" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Wasser, Solar, Energie, Vogtlandkreis, Biogas, Geothermie. The listing shows 2025-05-19 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
